name: Sleeve-Coil

Traits.name: Split-Seam Frenzy
Traits.text: While the sleeve-coil is Bloodied, it makes one additional Bite attack as part of Multiattack and has Advantage on attacks against creatures that have the Prone or Grappled condition.
Traits.clause: While Bloodied, the stitching splits and the knot loosens: the sleeve-coil gains one additional Bite attack when it take
Traits.expresses: a knot of eels writhing inside a man's coat
Traits.expressedQuote: it makes one additional Bite attack as part of Multiattack and has Advantage on attacks against creatures that have the Prone or Grappled condition.

Traits.name: Eel-Slip
Traits.text: The sleeve-coil ignores Difficult Terrain, and Opportunity Attacks against it are made with Disadvantage.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The sleeve-coil makes two Bite attacks.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Fleet Agility
Bonus Actions.text: The sleeve-coil takes the Dash or Disengage action.

lore: A drowned coat left in the bog and bred through with eels has become one hungry body, seeking only to be filled and dragged back under the water.
